name: Rally
description: Rally (Vanguard): +4 attack per turn, applied to the whole party.

name: Poison Coat
description: Poison Coat (Rogue): no effect by itself each turn — while active, every damaging hit the bearer lands also applies "Poisoned" to whoever got hit (on-hit rider, see docs/technical-decisions.md §4.2).

name: Poisoned
description: Poison Coat/Poison Bomb (Rogue): lose 4 HP per turn.

name: Burning
description: Fireball/Fire Pillar (Mage): lose 5 HP per turn. Not curable via mini-game (deliberate — distinguishes it from Poisoned).

name: Weakened
description: Crush (Skeleton Guard - Boss): lowers the target's defense for a few turns.

name: Stunned
description: Lightning Bolt/Lightning Storm (Mage): skips the turn entirely while active (see docs/technical-decisions.md §4.3). Not curable via mini-game.
